acceptance_threshold: non-empty; date column parses; no duplicate (date, borough) rows.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- an aggregate demand panel, training and backtest input rather than a canonical entity. It is the target of the AAR booster in docs/MODEL_CARDS.md.
derived_artifacts: GOVERNANCE-ONLY MANIFEST (tools/build_realdata_manifests.py). These bytes were hand-acquired before the governed estate existed and live at the paths below. Nothing was moved, copied or re-downloaded, and NO .acquired.json record is written -- this dataset did not go through packages.estate.acquire, and claiming it did would forge the provenance the estate exists to make trustworthy.
geography: New York City, by borough (the AAR service area).
license_and_commercial_rights: NYC Open Data / MTA open data -- published for public use including commercial use, with no registration or API key. The MTA's open-data terms permit reuse and redistribution with attribution. NOTE: this is an AGGREGATE demand panel; no individual rider record is present or derivable.
owner_and_source: New York City Transit / MTA, Access-A-Ride paratransit. Published via the MTA open-data programme and NYC Open Data. Acquired by hand into realdata/ before the governed estate (ADR-0013) existed; this manifest records the rights that were never written down, it does not re-acquire the data.
retention_and_deletion: retained indefinitely as committed evidence -- the evidence registry pins these panels by sha256 and the forecast leaderboard traces values to them, so deleting them would break reproducibility rather than free space. Public aggregate data; no deletion obligation exists.
schema_and_format: CSV / gzipped CSV. realdata/panels/aar_daily.csv (daily scheduled trips) and realdata/panels/aar_hourly_borough.csv.gz (borough-hour demand).
update_frequency: static snapshot -- these are committed panels, deliberately frozen so the model cards, the forecast leaderboard and the evidence registry stay reproducible.
